scope: A curated set of public data sources matching TerraScope, not an exhaustive inventory of the internet.

datasets.name: Sentinel-2 L2A via Google Earth Engine
datasets.status: Live API verified; field ingestion integrated
datasets.license: Copernicus Sentinel data terms; preserve source attribution
provides: Earth Engine scene search by field boundary, date and cloudiness
NDVI, NDRE, NDMI, SAVI and EVI calculated on the Earth Engine API
Valid-pixel coverage and scene-linked map tiles
datasets.limits: Live queries require a registered Earth Engine Cloud project with the API enabled and ADC authorized for the backend. Clear-pixel masking and the existing minimum field coverage/pixel-count policy remain in force. Health scores are experimental derived indicators, not measured yield.

datasets.name: NASA POWER daily meteorology
datasets.resolution: Gridded daily estimates, not an on-farm weather station
datasets.license: NASA POWER data policy and citation guidance
provides: Temperature
Corrected precipitation
Relative humidity
datasets.limits: Coordinates required. Meteorological availability trails by about 2–3 days; fill values are excluded. Weather at a nearby grid cell is not proof of actual irrigation.

datasets.name: Open-Meteo seven-day forecast
provides: Daily minimum/maximum temperature
Precipitation amount and probability
Humidity and wind speed
datasets.limits: Forecasts are modeled predictions, not historical observations or on-farm measurements. Requires field coordinates; forecast issue time is not provided.

datasets.name: Fields of the World — India boundaries
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0; attribute original authors and FTW/Kerner Lab
provides: Public sample parcel polygons
Coordinates and boundary-derived area
datasets.limits: A three-parcel static extract is retained for research and attribution only; it is not imported into the app. Historical benchmark polygons are not the user's farms. Crop type, current planting/harvest dates and yield are not supplied.

datasets.name: NASA Harvest CropHarvest
datasets.coverage: Global agricultural labels from multiple source datasets
datasets.resolution: Labelled points/polygons with associated remote-sensing time series
datasets.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 for CropHarvest; constituent source terms also apply
provides: Verified labels.geojson downloaded from pinned Zenodo record 10251170
Reproducible local HDF5 feature-manifest training/evaluation pipeline
87,464 official processed HDF5 samples with verified archive MD5 and per-file SHA-256 receipts
datasets.limits: 113,893 benchmark labels and 87,464 processed feature samples acquired. Source-specific training attribution and held-out evaluation remain separate. No trained model or accuracy is claimed; these are not current farm measurements.

datasets.name: ESA WorldCereal 2021 v100
datasets.status: Integrated through Google Earth Engine; active-field result persisted
datasets.coverage: Global 2021 products; seasonal coverage varies by agro-ecological zone
provides: Field-area-weighted 2021 annual temporary-crop classification and confidence via Earth Engine
Historical AOI GeoTIFF import remains available with source checksum validation
datasets.limits: The active development field has a 99.95% mapped-area coverage result; 2.28% of its whole area was classified as temporary crops. This is a historical binary classification, not current crop identity. Regional AEZ images are mosaicked as documented by ESA.

datasets.name: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200
datasets.status: Field result integrated in local development database
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0; include ESA WorldCover/Copernicus attribution
provides: Official FlatGeobuf tile index and intersecting S3 raster tile acquisition
Nodata-aware equal-area field clipping, land-cover classes and cropland percent
datasets.limits: A local user-reported field result is persisted; verify the boundary before interpretation. Cropland is not an individual crop type or cadastral boundary.

datasets.name: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0
datasets.status: Field result integrated in local development database
datasets.resolution: 250 m native grid; surface 0–5 cm currently requested
provides: WCS AOI coverage for pH, organic carbon, nitrogen and sand/silt/clay
Mean, Q0.05, Q0.95 and uncertainty with source units/scaling
datasets.limits: One local development field result has 17.68% spatial coverage and must not be treated as representative of the whole field. Modeled estimates do not replace soil tests; the REST API is temporarily paused by ISRIC.

datasets.name: UCSB CHIRPS v3 rainfall
datasets.status: Daily field rainfall persisted in local development database
provides: Official daily final-rnl and preliminary-sat selection with missing-day handling
Area-weighted daily mm and monthly totals with revision/source attribution
datasets.limits: Local field data covers 1 September–24 October 2026 and includes missing/preliminary days; consult the field panel for completeness. Separate product, not a drop-in replacement for all NASA weather variables.

datasets.name: FAO Crop Calendar
datasets.coverage: Selected countries, crops and agroecological zones
provides: Field-scoped validated manual CSV import with source, license, access date and permission reference
Clearly labeled regional recommendations; actual farmer dates are unchanged
datasets.limits: No permitted direct bulk-download workflow verified. User must provide and review a permission-sourced CSV; provenance is recorded, not independently certified.

datasets.name: DES Area, Production & Yield reports
datasets.status: District APY CSVs acquired locally from the India Data Portal mirror
datasets.coverage: India; DES dataset 1997–2023 and DES/UPAg district dataset 2013–14 to 2024–25
datasets.resolution: Aggregated state or district crop statistics
datasets.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License listed by the mirror; confirm for redistribution
provides: Local source CSVs and a Uttar Pradesh wheat/rice 2021–22 onward subset under ignored .local/datasets/yield/raw/
Area, production and yield with source units and checksums recorded in a manifest
datasets.limits: District aggregates are not measured farm yields and must not be copied into individual field records. Data is sourced via a third-party mirror; preserve crop codes, units and provenance and review terms before redistribution.

datasets.name: UPAg Domestic Crop Calendar
datasets.coverage: Indian states, seasons and crops as listed by the portal
datasets.license: Government portal; reuse terms need confirmation
provides: Domestic crop calendar reference and regional sowing/harvest windows
datasets.limits: The portal identifies its calendar source as ICAR and Indian Horticulture Database 2014. This is dated regional guidance, not field-specific dates or current observations; confirm source terms before redistribution.

datasets.name: ICAR Kharif Agro-Advisories for Farmers 2025
datasets.coverage: India; crop and regional advisories include Uttar Pradesh
datasets.license: No redistribution license identified; review ICAR terms
provides: Kharif crop practices and timing recommendations, including Uttar Pradesh rice
datasets.limits: Saved in the local ignored calendar cache and linked here for reference. This PDF is not a structured crop calendar or field observation; do not redistribute until terms are confirmed.

datasets.name: PLDD-UP: Potato Leaf Disease Dataset from Uttar Pradesh, India
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0; attribute dataset contributors Prakash Kumar Singh and Aseem Chandel and the Mendeley Data record. Review downstream model and deployment obligations separately.
datasets.coverage: Field-collected potato leaf photographs from Mainpuri, Etawah and Jaswantnagar, Uttar Pradesh, India
datasets.resolution: Photographs; no satellite or field-boundary resolution
datasets.verification: Source archives have verified SHA-256 checksums; extracted images were reported decoded by Pillow. The reproducible local inventory pipeline additionally checks every image and checksum.
datasets.provenance: Mendeley Data, DOI 10.17632/3j4nfkvp2n.1; dataset contributors Prakash Kumar Singh and Aseem Chandel; field photographs collected in Uttar Pradesh during Rabi 2025-26.
datasets.intendedUse: Research classification, model training/evaluation and demonstrations only; source photographs are referenced locally and are not stored in PostgreSQL.
provides: 15,519 field-collected images across Healthy (4,600), Early Blight (4,803) and Late Blight (6,116)
Offline inventory, image validation, exact/perceptual duplicate audit and grouped training manifest
Optional isolated experimental classifier pipeline; no model is claimed trained until evaluation artifacts exist
datasets.limits: Leaf photographs are not live satellite crop-health observations or satellite-matched field labels. The dataset is not representative of all Uttar Pradesh districts or potato varieties. No validated commercial diagnosis is provided; experimental probabilities are not diagnostic confidence. CC BY 4.0 attribution is required and does not settle every downstream model or deployment obligation.
